items.name: 01d-hero-no-sink
items.prompt: A real small utility room in a British house: a white front-loading washing machine and a white tumble dryer side by side under a continuous white oak worktop, a sage green shaker base cupboard to their right under the same worktop, sage green shaker wall cabinets above, an open oak shelf with woven baskets, terracotta floor tiles, a small window with daylight. No sink in the room. The washing machine has a round glass door and a detergent drawer; the tumble dryer is clearly different: a solid white round door with no glass window, no detergent drawer and a single plain unmarked dial. Plain unbranded appliances with blank control panels: no logos, no text, no numbers, plain unmarked dials. Realistic proportions at true real-world scale (appliances about 60 cm wide and 85 cm tall under a 90 cm worktop that sits on top of them). Shot like a real estate interior photo with a 24 mm lens at standing eye height, true-to-life materials, no CGI look. British home, no people, no text, no logos, square 1:1, high detail.
